design.decision: D12 source-only, as admitted by PR #1675
notes: The private payload is an OPTIONAL field `sourcePrivate` on ICampaignJournalEnvelope, a sibling of `campaignEvent`. Optional was mandatory: src/lib/campaign/sync/hostCampaignEventJournal.ts:150-153 constructs the envelope with all three fields explicit, and a required field would have stopped that co-op host path compiling. That file was NOT edited and did not need to be.

Conditional absence is implemented in toAppendEvent: the payload object literal is built WITHOUT the key and the key is spread on only when a private payload exists. Never `{}`, never an enumerable `undefined`. Pinned by a byte-exact canonical-payload assertion plus a pinned event digest and a pinned campaign state digest, all three captured from the base commit before any source edit.
The private payload rides the TERMINAL event of a command batch, exactly like expectedPostStateDigest, so it commits atomically with the batch and is covered by the journal digest chain.

The private field STAYS inside the digest material. EventJournalCanonicalizer was not touched. The accepted RE-4 residual -- the delivered projectedEventIdentity is a one-way commitment over bytes including the private field -- is pinned as EXPECTED by a row that reads delivery_event_mapping.projected_event_identity and asserts it equals the stored eventDigest.

Money is a class and cannot be canonicalized (the canonicalizer rejects non-plain prototypes), so the private payload is stored in the same JSON-safe form serializeCampaign already persists (Money.toJSON collapses to a C-bill number) and read back through the existing rehydrateCampaignMission / rehydrateContractMarket path. No new serialization convention was invented.

campaignSourcePrivateOf takes a minimal structural carrier type rather than IStoredEvent<ICampaignJournalEnvelope>, so the new authority module has no import edge back into sync/JournalCampaignEventStore and no cycle exists in either direction.

replayCampaignSourceContracts starts from the EARLIEST private row's captured sourceRecordBody, parses its contractMarket as the baseline market, and folds forward. It never reads the compact genesis snapshot. Baseline self-consistency (body bytes vs captured digest) and schema version are checked, and both refuse with a typed CampaignSourcePrivateReplayError rather than falling back to the compact projection.

RE-2 discharged: projectCampaignStreamForGrant.ts no longer narrows inline; `const event = envelopeOf(stored);` with envelopeOf added to the value import the file already took from JournalCampaignEventStore. envelopeOf's own body and return shape are unchanged.

nonClaims: No P1 producer. src/stores/campaign/campaignCommandActions.ts, src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignCommandPipeline.ts and src/pages/api/campaigns/[id]/commands.ts were NOT touched; nothing in production constructs a private envelope today. The carriage exists; no caller fills it.
No flag flip. CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_ENABLED remains false and was not read or written by this change.
No cutover, no migration-state change, no CAMP witness, no runtime exercise of a live stack.

The borrowed-handle campaign write with CAS plus a durable sourceReplayFence in src/services/campaignPersistence/CampaignPersistenceService.ts -- named in tasks.md 6.1 -- is NOT implemented here. Task 6.1 is therefore only PARTIALLY discharged by this commit; its tasks.md checkbox was deliberately left unchecked.

The baseline capture is carried as a typed field of the private envelope and pinned by tests, but nothing in this change captures it under the P0a prepared transaction (SQLiteEventJournalWriter.appendPreparedWithExtension). That wiring belongs with the producer.

resolutions.assertionShape: Each row asserts BOTH `expect(() => read()).toThrow(CampaignSourcePrivateReplayError)` AND pins `.reason` through a `refusalReasonOf` helper that rethrows any non-CampaignSourcePrivateReplayError and throws outright when the read RETURNS. A bare toThrow would pass on a TypeError and would not distinguish a refusal from a crash, nor catch a silent compact fallback.
